reverse_cursed_technique.__info__: Reverse Cursed Technique: an incantation made from Heal (Magic and Goods 6421). You cast it with the flame cast of Black Flame Blade (motion 32): the hand takes the fire, throws a small round burst of fire at the weapon, and for 20 seconds you heal over time (the buff, SpEffect 1642100: -45 HP, -15 FP and stamina regeneration 100 every 0.5 s), with blue fire (the positive curse energy), a deep red-purple ring of runes at the hand (the negative curse energy it converts) and the Positive Curse Energy Eyes, glowing blue. It is sold once by Kale. `kind` and `from`: kind projectile copies the rows of spell `from` (6421) with their own ids; the id of this spell in the game is not the key above but 2230000 + slot - 1 (slot 1 = 2230000): after a build the vault's spells.resolved.json says every id that was really used. `requires.status` is what the character needs to learn it, `requires.cost` what casting takes, `locations` where it is sold, `customs.basic` the numbers of the game's rows that are changed (built into regulation.bin) and `customs.advanced` what is put into the running game after the world loads (texts and colours).

basic.__info__: Level 2: Numbers written over the copies of the game's rows; the key is <Table>.<row id>.<field>. SpEffect.1642100 is the buff the spell gives: effectEndurance = seconds it lasts, motionInterval = seconds between heartbeats, changeHpRate / changeMpRate / changeStaminaRate = % of max HP / FP / stamina per heartbeat (negative heals; 1.8.3: 25 / 25 / 38), changeHpPoint / changeMpPoint = HP and FP per heartbeat on top (0: none; the template's Heal gives 230 HP once when left out), staminaRecoverChangeSpeed = faster stamina, vfxId = visual on the body (-1: none). Magic.6421: refType = cast motion (32: Black Flame Blade), castSfxId / fireSfxId = the effects of the cast and of the burst (524400 / 524401: the fire of Flame, Grant Me Strength, the only ones `colors` can recolour). Bullet.10642100.sfxId_Bullet = the visual of the thrown burst (-1: none). Bullet.10642101.sfxId_Bullet = the visual of the second bullet, Heal's ring around the caster when the cast ends (4271: a burst of ice shards with sparks, the one `colors` can recolour). SpEffect.1642100.vfxId1 / vfxId2 = 20090050 / 20090051: the Positive Curse Energy Eyes on the buff (both eyes; their colour is in `colors`). Goods.6421.iconId = the inventory icon (6806: Gravitational Missile). Changing anything here builds regulation.bin again.

advanced.__info__: Level 3: things that are not in regulation.bin. `eldendisk run` writes them into the game's memory once the character is in the world (a scan of the game's memory, about 4 seconds), and they last until the game closes. `texts`: goods_name = the name (shop and inventory), goods_info = the short line (shop and inventory), goods_caption = the long description (inventory and memory slot). `colors` (1.8.3): a key is the param field that points at an effect (Magic.6421.castSfxId: the fire while casting, 524400; Magic.6421.fireSfxId: the burst when the cast ends, 524401; SpEffectVfx.20090050.midstSfxId: the Positive Curse Energy Eyes, 4866; Bullet.10642101.sfxId_Bullet: the sparks when the cast ends, 4271; Sfx.515000 / Sfx.515001: the ring of runes at the hand, which no param names); under it every colour place of that effect file by its offset, the colour that place has: [red, green, blue, alpha] as the file holds it (above 1 shines brighter), or "#RRGGBB" (the place keeps its own brightness and alpha). A place left out keeps the game's colour. `read ...design.customs.advanced.colors` shows what the game holds now; `write ...colors.<key>.<place>=...` changes one place in the running game. The effect files are the game's own and shared, so the colours are for the whole game session. Changing only this part never builds regulation.bin again.

texts.goods_info: Converts negative curse energy into a positive cursed energy that resurrects over time.
texts.goods_caption: Two currents of profound malice colliding can create a vibrant spark of life capable of reversing death. This paradox was brought to the Lands Between by an Unknown Sorcerer—a dimension-jumping wanderer who manipulated unseen energy. Leaving behind only this absolute contradiction, the sorcerer vanished back to their distant home, acting either out of calculated miracle or a fleeting whim.

colors.__info__: Base of Light Blue Color Palette from https://www.figma.com/colors/light-blue/, I've adjusted Monochromatic Color Palette Sets, using #E0F3FF as the Negative Cursed Energy, and #90D5FF as the Positive Cursed Energy for the concept.

dismantle.__info__: Dismantle (1.8.4): an incantation made from Bestial Sling (Magic and Goods 6800), cast with the flick of the hand of Catch Flame (motion 106). One cast cuts everything in front of you, 100 m deep: 38 invisible cuts, one every 5 degrees (from -92 to +93), that go through characters, objects and the ground and hit each target once, slash damage scaled by the seal, blood, the bleed, no knockdown. Its id in the game is 2230001 (slot 2).

basic.__info__: Level 2: numbers written over the copies of the game's rows, the key is <Table>.<row id>.<field> (the row id is the template's, Bestial Sling 6800: the build writes them over the copies of slot 2). A field that calls another row may name a row of the game instead of a number ("SpEffect.474"): the build copies that row into this slot (the game's row stays as it is) and keys of that row change the copy. Each part below starts with its __info_<part>__. Changing anything here builds regulation.bin again.
basic.__info_cast__: The cast: Magic.6800.refType = the motion (106: Catch Flame's flick of the hand; Bestial Sling's own is 38; locked on, the script DismantleFollowsTheLockOn makes it 25, O, Flame!'s), castSfxId = the effect on the caster while casting (4122; -1: none). Goods.6800.iconId = the inventory icon (6254: Bloodboon's).
basic.__info_fan__: The fan of cuts, Bullet.10680000 (Bestial Sling's 11 stones): numShoot = how many, shootAngle = the first one's angle, shootAngleInterval = whole degrees between two (38 x 5 = from -92 to +93; locked on, the script puts the 38 on one line at the target). initVellocity / maxVellocity = m/s, life = seconds (120 m/s x 0.84 s = 100 m; no gravity, no slowing down: the template's), lifeRandomRange = seconds the game adds or takes from life at random (0: always 100 m), dist = range. hitRadius = metres each cut is wide at the hand, hitRadiusMax = at the end, spreadTime = seconds it takes to grow (100 m away two cuts are 8.7 m apart: 4.5 m each side leaves no gap). isPenetrateMap 1 = through the ground and walls (a cut this wide touches the ground at once, and a cut that hits the map ends there). sfxId_Bullet = what flies (-1: nothing, the blade is invisible), sfxId_Hit = an effect where a cut ends, on a target or not (-1: none; what the ones hit show is in the SpEffects below). createLimitGroupId 0 = no limit of the game's group 42.
basic.__info_cut__: The cut, AtkParam_Pc.68000 (of every cut): atkPhys = physical damage of one cut before the seal's scaling (a target is hit once a cast; locked on, by all 38), atkAttribute 0 = slash (1 strike, 2 pierce, 3 standard), atkMaterial = what hits, which picks the game's own hit look and sound on what is hit (0: metal, as a sword; 6: magic, Bestial Sling's).
basic.__info_bleed__: The bleed: Bullet.10680000.spEffectId0 = a copy of SpEffect 1625 (the bleed a game bullet carries), bloodAttackPower = bleed per hit; when the meter is full the target loses 15% of its max HP + 100 (the game's).
basic.__info_blood__: The blood on the ones hit, and only on them (a bullet's SpEffects go only to the ones it hits): Bullet.10680000.spEffectId1 = a copy of SpEffect 474 (a game row that takes HP from the one a bullet hits), emptied: changeHpRate / changeHpPoint 0 (takes nothing), invocationConditionsStateChange1 0 (on every target, not only those in the game's state 452), effectEndurance = seconds it stays, vfxId 6 = the burst of blood of a hemorrhage (effect 4080 at the middle of the body, the visual of every bleed of the game).
basic.__info_claw_marks__: The claw marks next to the blood on the ones hit are not in regulation.bin: the default script DismantleFollowsTheLockOn makes the game's unused SpEffectVfx row 999999999 play Beast Claw's claw marks (530172; locked on the charged Beast Claw's, 530177, bigger) at the middle of the body, and points the copy of SpEffect 474 at it (vfxId1), in the running game only. Without the scripts, the blood alone.
basic.__info_stones__: Bestial Sling's 3 homing stones of the same cast, Bullet.10680001: numShoot 0 = none, nothing to see.

texts.goods_info: Unleashes invisible slashes that cut everything in a wide arc far ahead.
texts.goods_caption: Incantation of the Unknown Sorcerer. Unleashes unseen slashes that cleave all before the caster; upon a foe held in the caster's gaze, every blade converges. Keep, tree and beast fell alike in clean pieces, and those who lived spoke only of a faint wind, and the blood that followed.
